one_line: An offline maternal-health assistant for community health workers: patient onboarding with clinical risk scoring, personalized daily tips and wellness check-ins, and RAG-grounded symptom triage — all on a local laptop with no cloud and no internet.
cross_disciplinary_integration: Health + information retrieval: offline RAG (local sentence-embedding model + FAISS vector search) over a clinician-approved maternal-health corpus grounds the LLM's triage answers. A deterministic clinical risk rubric and a local SQLite datastore complete the patient journey.
components: Onboarding + risk scoring (deterministic clinical rubric, no LLM)
Symptom triage grounded in a clinician-approved corpus (local LLM + offline RAG)
Local SQLite database for patient records and conversation history
notes: NURA Edge is the offline core of the NURA maternal-health platform (a production FastAPI system). It replaces the platform's hosted LLM with a local quantized model, eliminating per-token API fees and connectivity requirements so a clinic can run it on hardware it already owns.
